scope: 54 optional-inclusive unmeasured names: historical current-default 50 plus js-exec/python/python3/node. node positive plan is blocked by pinned stub. No existing recipe/report modified.
expectations: Proposed contracts and static-source-informed expectations, not recorded passes or native captures. Freeze exact input bytes and independently validate oracle/launcher before running. Preserve all failures and unavailable setup without denominator deletion.
sharedFixtureRules: Fresh memory filesystem and single exec for stateful workflows.
Create /fixture and /fixture/tmp outside asserted setup; fixture files UTF-8 unless explicit encoding; repeat-utf8 descriptors materialize exact repeated bytes.
Default files 0644, directories 0755, synthetic fixed mtime 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z; no SGID tests/retries.
Snapshot only asserted /fixture namespace, retain built-in /bin and /proc setup separately.
Default empty stdin is explicit; no probing or consumption to infer provenance.
No host native process in product path. All future native files confined to unique executor-owned /tmp scratch.
Do not collapse dependency failure into target failure; keep blocked targets counted as unmeasured until independently exercised.
Freeze every raw stdout/stderr byte and full VFS effects before choosing any comparison projection.
